Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Systematically organized form submission created by a visitor or authenticated user with a unique ID.

formType.description: Category of form submitted on the app

userId.description: Firebase Auth user UID if signed in

userEmail.description: Contact email provided in form or auth profile

userName.description: Name of the founder, developer, or submitter

appName.description: Name of the B2B or Shopify application

status.description: Current processing state of the submission

summary.description: Concise human-readable summary of form payload

details.description: Structured payload containing specific form fields

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Collection of all visitor and user form submissions organized with unique IDs.
